preserve: Only POST /tools/run may receive the every-plan placement exemption; the tool must name at least one placement and every placement must explicitly have settings.included_in_every_plan true
withheld reads the account owner's access and applies the existing withheldFeature predicate with the actual path and method
A refusal's words come from withheldWords with the actual feature, decisionAllowance, origin and upgradeOfferFor result; the body retains upgrade_needed and the feature
A named upgrade offer wins; otherwise the original account-owner fact and upgrade-arm supplier are consulted, retaining the optional arm lookup fallback
The original refusal precedes the placement exemption, preserving source-unavailable failures rather than treating unavailable access as an included plan
allowed_deltas: Lift the three complete PersonStore methods into one owner-supplied composition with explicit trusted access, allowance, fact, workshop-row, feature-predicate, word and upgrade-arm suppliers
Reject absent or malformed authoritative access and catalogue supplies explicitly, without inventing a free plan or converting an auth/reach refusal into a plan denial
Compose the retained methods as refusalFor(request), returning the original refusal body or null; HTTP and MCP transports remain their existing owners
Test the actual preserved predicate with synthetic catalogue DATA and test the producer through opposing placement, policy and unavailable-source controls
banned_substitutions: A second platform plan policy or guessed capabilities
Seller content grants or generic authentication/reach failures standing in for platform entitlement
A blanket paid gate over tools whose placements all include every plan
Restoring the old JavaScript MCP transport or changing held public consumers
Live account, grant, plan, payment or credential mutations
qualification_boundary: Source-only producer composition. The current canonical native account.access read, owner-controlled operation entitlement and original service/publisher exemptions still require their qualified active binding.
